name: git-official-docs
instructions: The official documentation of Git, kept locally: the manual page of every git command, the guides of the Git documentation, and Git LFS (every git lfs command). Search with search_docs, then read one section with read_doc. Look it up rather than guess it.
search: Search the official documentation of Git: the manual page of every git command, the guides of the Git documentation, and every git lfs command. Returns 10 section ids at most.
